messages:
Lena K.: External pentest confirmed 2026-11-02 13:00-17:00 UTC. Need ephemeral RBAC, KMS upload pattern, evidence immutability, quick vuln triage flow, and retest slots. Who can pick pieces?

Victor P.: I can own RBAC + revoke automation. Plan: role `pt_assessor_role_<eng>` with trust to vendor account only, NoConsoleAccess, max session 60m. Will provide `revoke-role.sh`.

Isha R.: I'll handle KMS and compliance. Prefer encrypt-only grant for uploads; never grant Decrypt unless signed approval. If Decrypt happens, we'll rotate alias `alias/pt-evidence` -> `alias/pt-evidence-rotated-<eng>`.

Tom G.: Observability: create disposable CloudTrail `pt-trail-<eng>` exporting to `forensics-archive/pt/<eng>`. Snapshot at T+0 and T+end; enable object-lock on export objects. Also capture host auditd and proxy request IDs.

Lena K.: Tracker fields to include: engagement_id, vendor_arn, role_name, grant_ids, evidence_bucket, trail_export_link, retest_slots, triage_owner. Tracker URL: https://redwood/secure/pt-tracker/ENG-911 (internal).

Victor P.: IAM policy sketch for role (read-only view + presigned upload allowed, explicit deny deletes):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-readroom/<eng>/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-uploads/<eng>/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-*/*"}
  ]
}
```

Isha R.: KMS grant example for upload-only (replace GRANTEE_ARN):

`aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence --grantee-principal GRANTEE_ARN --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --name "pt-upload-<eng>"`

Isha R.: We'll record the returned GrantId in tracker and call `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id <id> --key-id <key>` at session end.

Tom G.: Alerts: CloudWatch alarm if `KMS Decrypt` > baseline*2 in 10m or any `S3:DeleteObject` attempt on pt buckets. PagerDuty accordingly.

Lena K.: Triage flow: open ticket per finding in tracker with severity label, owner, PR link, evidence link, and retest request. Keep retest slots 90 minutes. Proposed retest slots: 2026-11-04 14:00-15:30 UTC and 2026-11-05 09:00-10:30 UTC.

Victor P.: I'll staff Nov 5 retest and own grant retirement. Isha will staff Nov 4 for key-related validation.

sec-bot: Preflight checklist created for ENG-911. Reminder: preflight run 2026-11-01 16:00 UTC. Calendar invites sent.

Isha R.: Post-engagement checklist we should enforce: retire grants, revoke temp roles, archive and checksum trail export, rotate key if Decrypt was used, apply object-lock retention, and run smoke tests on critical services. I'll draft the minimal runbook and upload to the tracker by EOD.

Lena K.: Perfect. Action items: Victor = role + revoke script; Isha = KMS grant scripts + runbook; Tom = trail snapshot + alerts; Lena = tracker + calendar. Reconvene at preflight. Thanks all.
